what: Discovering what is available for download
title: Getting Started
text: flux_listall() R wrapper around command line program, fluxnet-shuttle, requires Python. first time run flux_listall(), Python virtual environment created fluxnet-shuttle installed . don’t appropriate version Python installed, may prompted tips install . default, results flux_listall() saved user cache, run ’ll pull results unless older cach_age. ignore cache, use use_cache = FALSE. invalidate cache (replace updated one), use cache_age = -Inf. list returned flux_listall() contains metadata available sites including, importantly, citations site-level data attribution required FLUXNET.

title: Getting Started
text: paths downloading FLUXNET data. just want download everything available, simply run flux_download(). can download just specific sites site_ids argument, can filter results flux_listall() pass .

title: Getting Started
text: can read data passing manifest flux_read(). can read data just select sites site_ids argument, complex filtering can simply subset manifest object first.
code: # Read all available annual data annual <- flux_read(manifest, resolution = "y") #> Reading 10 files. ## NOT RUN ## # Read in hourly data from specific sites hourly <- flux_read(   manifest,   resolution = "h",   site_ids = c("AR-CCg", "AR-TF1") )  # Read in only ERA5 data annual_era5 <- flux_read(manifest, resolution = "y", datasets = "ERA5")  # Filter manifest to just sites with "WET" for IGBP n_wet_manifest <-   left_join(manifest, list, by = join_by(site_id)) %>%   filter(igbp == "WET", location_lat > 0)  n_wet_monthly <- flux_read(n_wet_manifest, resolution = "m")

title: Download, read, and visualize FLUXNET data

title: Download, read, and visualize FLUXNET data

code: library(fluxnet) ## List all available FLUXNET data flux_listall()  ## Download all available FLUXNET data flux_download()  ## Extract all the annual data files from the downloads flux_extract(resolutions = "y")  ## Create manifest manifest <- flux_discover_files()  ## Read in data annual <- flux_read(manifest, resolution = "y")

title: Download FLUXNET zip files — flux_download
text: Downloads zip files (one per site) available FLUXNET sites.

title: Download FLUXNET zip files — flux_download
code: flux_download(   file_list_df = NULL,   site_ids = "all",   download_dir = "fluxnet",   overwrite = FALSE,   ... )

title: Download FLUXNET zip files — flux_download
text: file_list_df NULL (default), flux_listall() used determine sites data available download (specific sites can selected site_ids).  file_list_df supplied, data frame generated flux_listall(), potentially filtered exlude rows. provides alternative way downloading specific sites. See examples possible use case. file_list_df NULL, cache_dir, use_cache, cache_age ingored site_ids "" still used. site_ids Character; either "" download sites available, vector site IDs. example, c("UK-GaB", "CA-Ca2"). download_dir directory download zip files . overwrite Logical; overwrite already downloaded .zip files? FALSE skip downloading existing files, unless invalid .zip files (e.g. due partial download corruption). ... Arguments passed flux_listall().

title: Download FLUXNET zip files — flux_download
text: Invisibly returns tibble download URL, path disk, HTTP status code, whether download successful.

title: Download FLUXNET zip files — flux_download
code: if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{ # Download data for all available sites flux_download()  # Download data for just select site IDs flux_download(site_ids = c("UK-GaB", "CA-Ca2"))  # Download specific sites filtered by site metadata (IGPB  and data hub for example) available_sites <- flux_listall() to_get <-   available_sites[available_sites$igbp == "CRO" & available_sites$data_hub == "AmeriFlux", ] flux_download(file_list_df = to_get)  # Get a fresh list of available data and overwrite any existing downloads flux_download(use_cache = FALSE, overwrite = FALSE) } # }

title: Flag overly-gapfilled data — flux_qc
code: if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{  # Flag rows where NEE_VUT_REF is more than 50% gapfilled manifest <- flux_discover_files() annual <- flux_read(manifest, resolution = "y") annual_flagged <- flux_qc(   annual,   qc_vars = "NEE_VUT_REF",   max_gapfilled = 0.5 )  # Use multiple variables each with a different threshold for QC annual_flagged2 <- flux_qc(   annual,   qc_vars = c("NEE_VUT_REF", "TA_F"),   max_gapfilled = c(0.4, 0.6) )  # Same as above, but require *both* variables to be above their thresholds # to consider that row a problem annual_flagged2 <- flux_qc(   annual,   qc_vars = c("NEE_VUT_REF", "TA_F"),   max_gapfilled = c(0.4, 0.6),   operator = "all" )  } # }

title: fluxnet (development version)
text: flux_extract() gains network argument specify subset networks (e.g. ICOS, TERN) extract data . Suggested @lbell3141. Added flux_qc(), function flag overly gapfilled rows aggregated (hourly) data. Added flux_map_sites(). flux_download() now uses httr2 rather curl downloading files. fixed bug downloads failing attempting download large numbers sites . Added flux_map_sites() flux_download() prints warning downloads fail. Changed default cache age flux_listall() 1 day. flux_download() now retries failed downloads overwrite = FALSE longer skips downloading corrupted partial downloads. Added flux_read() reading FLUXNET data manifest. Added flux_discover_files() creating file manifest.
